review_source.source: PR #4344 trusted review for fallback head a9fd542d34673ac4c0cb4343578dac656fde6b10
review_source.rule: The reviewer data gaps and conditional follow-ups are accepted as future-input contracts. They are not disputed, erased, or represented as evidence already obtained.

truth_boundary.rule: Organizer-owned or external evidence may be absent while the participant's method is complete. Absence keeps the relevant release on HOLD; it does not create a fictional participant-design defect or authorize a substitute fact.

reviewer_gaps.reviewer_gap_summary: Official SITE_BOUNDARY, KEY_AREA and 43.6 km2 coordinate basis are not available for this submission.
reviewer_gaps.trigger: Organizer releases a usable, versioned official geometry/data package for participant refinement.
reviewer_gaps.minimum_valid_future_artifact: Versioned SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA geometry with official status, CRS, provenance, issue date and permitted-use scope; the 43.6 km2 basis if applicable.
reviewer_gaps.participant_prepared_method: Official geometry rebind register and D0-GATE-FRESH-001; provisional layers remain explicitly qualified until replacement.
reviewer_gaps.recalculation_or_rebinding_action: Rebuild topology from the same official source version, recompute dependent metrics, regenerate visual references, issue a version-diff receipt and invalidate stale provisional derivations.
reviewer_gaps.fallback_if_absent: Keep provisional constraint labels, retain typological reasoning only, and do not make location-specific implementation releases.
reviewer_gaps.false_claim_prohibited: Do not call provisional geometry official or use it as a statutory, parcel, capacity or approval basis.
reviewer_gaps.current_release_effect: R0/R1 true within participant scope; R2 package-ready only; R3-R6 false/HOLD.

reviewer_gaps.reviewer_gap_summary: Applicable FAR, height, setbacks, redlines and statutory planning controls are unavailable.
reviewer_gaps.future_evidence_owner_type: applicable planning/control authority or authorized data custodian
reviewer_gaps.trigger: Applicable official planning-control package or a qualified professional control interpretation becomes available for the same future carrier/scope.
reviewer_gaps.minimum_valid_future_artifact: Versioned official control drawing/text or authoritative professional record stating applicability, scope, date, source and unresolved conditions.
reviewer_gaps.participant_prepared_method: Control-input rebind record; existing FAR/height values remain unknown/null and cannot be backfilled by inference.
reviewer_gaps.recalculation_or_rebinding_action: Map applicable controls to the same carrier, revise/reject the future alternative as necessary, and issue a diff receipt before any R3 consideration.
reviewer_gaps.fallback_if_absent: ALT-00 ordinary city / NO-BUILD or carrier-neutral desk review only.
reviewer_gaps.false_claim_prohibited: Do not infer legal controls, clearance, buildability or approval from context, diagrams or generic standards.
reviewer_gaps.current_release_effect: No R3 carrier preparation, procurement or activation.

reviewer_gaps.reviewer_gap_summary: The Dazhongsi provisional area and station-context anchor have a declared offset that requires future correction.
reviewer_gaps.future_evidence_owner_type: organizer official data steward and applicable station/interface data custodian
reviewer_gaps.trigger: Official south KEY_AREA geometry and current station/interface source become available with a permitted-use scope.
reviewer_gaps.minimum_valid_future_artifact: Versioned official south KEY_AREA plus current station-context/interface record with CRS, provenance, date and scope.
reviewer_gaps.participant_prepared_method: Explicit offset register and same-version rebind method; current proposal remains typological rather than parcel/station-corner specific.
reviewer_gaps.recalculation_or_rebinding_action: Replace provisional anchor, rebuild the affected topology and labels, recompute dependent output references and issue a diff receipt.
reviewer_gaps.fallback_if_absent: Retain only non-site-specific typology and do not use the south reference for physical implementation.
reviewer_gaps.false_claim_prohibited: Do not convert contextual station information into carrier, access, rights or operational facts.
reviewer_gaps.current_release_effect: R3-R6 remain false/HOLD for any south carrier-dependent action.

reviewer_gaps.reviewer_gap_summary: Building use, structure, fire, heritage, ownership, continuity and adaptation investigation has not occurred.
reviewer_gaps.future_evidence_owner_type: applicable qualified planning, architecture, structure, fire/life-safety, heritage and rights professionals
reviewer_gaps.trigger: A future carrier is genuinely proposed for professional review.
reviewer_gaps.minimum_valid_future_artifact: Same-carrier professional investigation records with scope, methods, date, applicable discipline signatory/role type, findings, limitations and accept/revise/reject outcome.
reviewer_gaps.participant_prepared_method: Professional discipline intake matrix, D0-GATE-FRESH-001 and A/B/C/D acceptance split.
reviewer_gaps.recalculation_or_rebinding_action: Bind findings to the actual carrier, revise/reject P0 or select a lower alternative, and update only scope-matched future records.
reviewer_gaps.fallback_if_absent: No carrier selection; ALT-01 or ALT-00.
reviewer_gaps.false_claim_prohibited: Do not treat concept polygons, public context or reference components as a building survey or professional conclusion.
reviewer_gaps.current_release_effect: No R3 preparation or R4 rehearsal.

reviewer_gaps.reviewer_gap_summary: Rights, access, opening rules, operator and statutory/professional responsibility are unconfirmed.
reviewer_gaps.future_evidence_owner_type: future rights-holder, authorized carrier steward and applicable appointing/authority role
reviewer_gaps.trigger: A future carrier/task is proposed beyond desk verification.
reviewer_gaps.minimum_valid_future_artifact: Current scope-specific rights/access evidence, opening/use rules, authorized signatory, role appointment/mandate, expiry/revocation and applicable responsibility record.
reviewer_gaps.participant_prepared_method: Frozen gate topology, role-phase separation pattern, common receipt contract and D0-GATE-FRESH-001.
reviewer_gaps.recalculation_or_rebinding_action: Validate scope, role and expiry; reject any incompatible role combination; issue a current release or retain HOLD.
reviewer_gaps.fallback_if_absent: No carrier preparation; retain ordinary city / NO-BUILD.
reviewer_gaps.false_claim_prohibited: Do not name a real operator, institution, rights-holder or responsible professional without their authoritative evidence.

reviewer_gaps.reviewer_gap_summary: Kerb, cycling, loading, emergency, utilities, trees, soil-water, thermal, night light/noise and maintenance field evidence is absent.
reviewer_gaps.future_evidence_owner_type: future qualified transport, municipal/utilities, ecology, accessibility, maintenance and emergency reviewers
reviewer_gaps.trigger: A future same-carrier intervention/rehearsal is considered after rights and professional scope exist.
reviewer_gaps.minimum_valid_future_artifact: Dated same-carrier observation/investigation records, applicable professional review, issue register and accept/revise/reject decision.
reviewer_gaps.participant_prepared_method: D0-S01-ROUTE-001, D0-S01-STOP-001, D0-S01-RESET-001 and the professional discipline intake matrix.
reviewer_gaps.recalculation_or_rebinding_action: Bind observed conditions to the actual carrier/time window, revise the alternative or terminate P0; do not extrapolate from conceptual geometry.
reviewer_gaps.fallback_if_absent: ALT-01 or ALT-00; no field-facing action.
reviewer_gaps.false_claim_prohibited: Do not present a proposed route, concept blue-green response or generic formula as a field observation or capacity conclusion.
reviewer_gaps.current_release_effect: No R4 rehearsal, R5 activation or R6 closeout claim.

reviewer_gaps.reviewer_gap_summary: S01/S04/S07 lack a real task, authorized carrier, qualified operating/safety roles, quotation, approved budget/funding and commissioning evidence.
reviewer_gaps.future_evidence_owner_type: future task owner, rights-holder/authorized carrier, qualified role appointing authority, procurement/funding authority and applicable professional reviewers
reviewer_gaps.trigger: A real task is proposed for a specific carrier after an ordinary/low-tech sufficiency test.
reviewer_gaps.minimum_valid_future_artifact: Bounded real task packet, current carrier rights/access, separated qualified role records, same-scope professional/field evidence, authorized procurement/quotation/budget/funding record and witnessed commissioning/rehearsal receipts where applicable.
reviewer_gaps.participant_prepared_method: Frozen alternatives, D0 methods, A/B/C/D acceptance hierarchy, release states, gate topology and receipt contract.
reviewer_gaps.recalculation_or_rebinding_action: Re-run alternative sufficiency, bind every future quantity/role-hour/cost method to the actual scope, validate fresh receipts, then accept/revise/reject without reusing participant indices as commercial facts.
reviewer_gaps.fallback_if_absent: Ordinary city / NO-BUILD, simulation, review or lower-tech reversible solution; no procurement or field activation.
reviewer_gaps.false_claim_prohibited: Do not convert participant reference quantities, role-hours or relative sensitivities into appointments, quotations, budgets, funding, procurement, commissioning or field performance.

conditional_followups.summary: Publish and explain official total boundary, KEY_AREA polygons, CRS/version and Dazhongsi/station relationship when organizer data is available.
conditional_followups.trigger: Organizer publishes usable official geometry or a formal data version.
conditional_followups.fallback: Provisional constraint stays provisional; no specific carrier release.

conditional_followups.summary: Rebuild topology and recompute geometry-derived measures, figures, matrices and south interfaces from one official source version; retain a version-diff receipt.
conditional_followups.trigger: Usable official SITE_BOUNDARY/KEY_AREA geometry is received.
conditional_followups.owner_type: participant author for rebinding after organizer input
conditional_followups.participant_prepared_method: Same-version topology rebuild, metrics refresh and diff receipt.
conditional_followups.fallback: Do not mix versions; retain qualified provisional outputs.

conditional_followups.summary: Perform a human substantive Chinese/English audit of claims, values, evidence states, warnings and figure placement before formal professional review, communication or publication.
conditional_followups.trigger: Future formal review, bilingual communication or external publication package review.
conditional_followups.participant_prepared_method: Aligned source pair and bilingual rendering/visual workflow; no translation difference is assumed resolved by code alone.
conditional_followups.fallback: Correct both language surfaces before relying on the affected claim.

conditional_followups.summary: Investigate carrier rights/access and applicable building, transport, municipal, ecology, accessibility, privacy/legal, fire/life-safety and operational responsibility before a G1 field candidate or physical rehearsal.
conditional_followups.trigger: S01, S04 or S07 is selected as a G1 field candidate or physical rehearsal is proposed.
conditional_followups.owner_type: shared future rights-holder, qualified professional and carrier roles
conditional_followups.participant_prepared_method: Professional discipline intake matrix; A/B/C/D acceptance; D0 route/stop/reset methods.
conditional_followups.fallback: HOLD/NO-GO; ordinary city or lower-tech alternative.

conditional_followups.summary: After real task/specification, authorized purchasing path and scope/date/location-matched quotation plus budget/funding evidence exist, recompute quantities, role-hours, CAPEX/OPEX and exit preparation.
conditional_followups.trigger: Future RFQ, budget decision or procurement phase.
conditional_followups.owner_type: future task/procurement/funding authority with participant rebinding role
conditional_followups.participant_prepared_method: D0-ALTERNATIVE-001, D0-GATE-FRESH-001 and scope-specific rebind receipt.
conditional_followups.fallback: No RFQ, award, payment, procurement or activation; relative indices remain non-commercial.

conditional_followups.summary: Recheck participant-registered time-sensitive public sources, site operating rules and external institution materials for status, scope and reuse conditions before formal site conclusion, collaboration or external outcome communication.
conditional_followups.trigger: A source is reused for a site conclusion, collaboration communication, implementation file or external outcome claim.
conditional_followups.owner_type: participant author with applicable source/rightsholder review
conditional_followups.participant_prepared_method: Source validity/expiry record under the common receipt contract.
conditional_followups.fallback: Retain background-only status or remove the dependent claim.

external_data_rebinding_contract.rights_provenance_requirement: Official status, publisher, issue/version date, permitted-use scope and CRS must be explicit.
external_data_rebinding_contract.validity: Current, source-bound and suitable for the intended refinement scope.
external_data_rebinding_contract.recalculation_rebinding_action: Rebuild from one same-version source set and record a diff receipt.
external_data_rebinding_contract.invalidation_rule: All provisional geometry-derived outputs are superseded only after the same-version rebuild is complete.

external_data_rebinding_contract.rights_provenance_requirement: Official calculation scope, boundary definition and version are required.
external_data_rebinding_contract.validity: Must match the disclosed official planning/scope basis.
external_data_rebinding_contract.recalculation_rebinding_action: Replace only the relevant scope statement; do not backfit local geometry without compatible source data.
external_data_rebinding_contract.invalidation_rule: Any statement using a different basis remains provisional/contextual.

external_data_rebinding_contract.input: FAR, height, setback and redline controls
external_data_rebinding_contract.rights_provenance_requirement: Applicable official control package or qualified interpretation with scope/date is required.
external_data_rebinding_contract.validity: Carrier- and scope-specific; generic planning context is insufficient.
external_data_rebinding_contract.recalculation_rebinding_action: Map controls to the actual carrier and revise/reject the alternative.
external_data_rebinding_contract.invalidation_rule: No statutory feasibility claim survives without applicable control evidence.

external_data_rebinding_contract.rights_provenance_requirement: Current official/interface source and permitted-use scope are required.
external_data_rebinding_contract.validity: Must be current and tied to the affected future interface.
external_data_rebinding_contract.recalculation_rebinding_action: Re-anchor affected context and regenerate only dependent claims.
external_data_rebinding_contract.invalidation_rule: Existing offset reference cannot become a station access conclusion.

external_data_rebinding_contract.rights_provenance_requirement: Dated authorized scope, signatory/role, expiry and revocation information are required.
external_data_rebinding_contract.validity: Must be current, scope-matched and independently reviewable.
external_data_rebinding_contract.recalculation_rebinding_action: Validate gate freshness and reject role conflicts.
external_data_rebinding_contract.invalidation_rule: Expired or mismatched evidence immediately returns the affected release to HOLD.

external_data_rebinding_contract.rights_provenance_requirement: Applicable qualified role, methods, site/time scope, limitations and outcome are required.
external_data_rebinding_contract.recalculation_rebinding_action: Bind findings to the actual task/carrier and revise or reject future configuration.
external_data_rebinding_contract.invalidation_rule: Concept drawings and proxy context do not survive as field/professional evidence.

external_data_rebinding_contract.input: real task, quotation, budget/funding and commissioning
external_data_rebinding_contract.rights_provenance_requirement: Real task scope, authorized commercial/financial evidence and commissioning authority are required.
external_data_rebinding_contract.recalculation_rebinding_action: Recalculate from real scope; participant relative indices cannot be converted directly.
external_data_rebinding_contract.invalidation_rule: No commercial, funding or activation claim until authoritative evidence is valid.

professional_discipline_intake_matrix.question: Which official controls and scope apply?
Can the future carrier support reversible interface and ordinary-city floor?
Are any future loads/anchorage/interface proposals applicable and acceptable?
Can a future arrangement preserve safety/egress and stop/isolation requirements?
Do route, kerb, cycling, loading and emergency conditions preserve ordinary movement?
Are utilities, isolation and maintenance interfaces acceptable?
Do trees, soil-water, thermal and night conditions permit a future reversible edge?
Do human route, handoff and non-digital fallback remain independently accessible?
Does future task/data/appeal scope have a lawful human route?
Does a future carrier/interface preserve applicable heritage constraints?
Can real scope, quotations, budget/funding and authority support a future commercial action?
